title: sdks-unify-auth-retries-streaming-ergonomics-parity-v1.154.1
author: Ava Chen
release_notes: SDK: unify auth/retries behavior across Python/TS/Go; streaming API ergonomics improvements; parity fixes and minor version bump to v1.154.1. No breaking changes for public API surface; internal retry behavior tightened with opt-in backfill for legacy clients.
description:
Motivation: This PR completes the v1.154.1 SDK roll that unifies auth and retry semantics across Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs and addresses streaming ergonomics and parity gaps observed during our Dedicated rollout. Goal is consistent developer ergonomics and predictable retry behavior across languages while fixing several small parity and documentation gaps.

Changeset summary (high-level):
- Python SDK: consolidated auth token refresh hook, unified retry policy implementation, streaming client ergonomic overloads for async generators, improved type hints and docs.
- TypeScript SDK: aligned retry backoff math with Python/Go, introduced unified auth middleware that supports short-lived tokens and automatic refresh, added streaming iterator helper and improved types for function-calls in streaming mode.
- Go SDK: added context-aware retry wrapper, fixed streaming chunk boundaries for partial JSON outputs, updated examples and README parity with other SDKs.
- Shared: bumped SDK package versions to v1.154.1, added cross-language conformance tests, updated changelogs and migration notes.

Checklist: 
- [x] Implement unified auth middleware across SDKs
- [x] Standardize retry/backoff defaults (exponential with jitter, max attempts configurable)
- [x] Streaming ergonomics improvements (helpers, clearer error semantics)
- [x] Parity fixes for examples and docs
- [x] Add cross-SDK conformance tests
- [x] Update changelogs and release notes

Commits (summary):
- feat(python): add TokenRefreshAuthHook + unify retry policy implementation
- feat(ts): add AuthMiddleware, standardize retry/backoff, streaming iterator helper
- fix(go): context-aware retries, streaming partial-json fix, update examples
- test: add cross-sdk conformance suite and fixtures
- docs: update SDK changelogs, migration guide, and examples

Files touched (representative):
- sdks/python/redwood/auth.py (added TokenRefreshAuthHook, tests)
- sdks/python/redwood/retries.py (refactor retry policy, add jitter and metrics)
- sdks/python/redwood/streaming.py (streaming helpers, async generator examples)
- sdks/typescript/src/middleware/auth.ts (AuthMiddleware, unit tests)
- sdks/typescript/src/retries.ts (backoff utils)
- sdks/typescript/src/streaming/iterator.ts (streaming iterator helper)
- sdks/go/redwood/auth.go (context-based token refresh)
- sdks/go/redwood/retry.go (retry wrapper)
- sdk-conformance/tests/streaming_parity/* (new fixtures)
- CHANGELOGs for each SDK

Review conversation (highlights):
- Diego Martinez: "Left a few nits around naming and one concurrency edge in python streaming; overall matches the spec. Please add explicit test for token refresh during long-lived streams."
- Ava Chen (author): "Added test and fixed concurrency by using a per-stream semaphore; addressed naming nits and pushed follow-up commit."
- Priya Kapoor: "TS middleware looks good; suggest tightening default maxAttempts from 5 -> 4 for interactive routes to reduce request storms. Can be overridden in config."
- Ava Chen: "Accepted; default changed and documented in migration notes."
- Liam O'Connor: "Go change is fine but please ensure context deadlines propagate to the retry wrapper — saw a potential leak."
- Ava Chen: "Patched retry wrapper to honor ctx.Done(), added unit test and an integration run."

CI and validation:
- Initial CI run: lint/test failed on a flaky streaming test in Go.
- Follow-up runs: fixed root cause (partial-json framing) in go streaming parser; re-ran integration tests.
- Final CI status: all checks passing (unit, lint, cross-sdk conformance, integration).

Backward compatibility and migration notes:
- No breaking changes to public method signatures.
- Default retry/backoff tightened slightly; customers who relied on previous maxAttempts can set explicit retry config.
- Token refresh is now automatic for short-lived tokens; legacy behavior can be restored by opting out in SDK config.

Testing performed:
- Unit tests across all three SDKs covering auth, retry, and streaming helpers.
- Cross-language conformance suite validating example flows (sync/async, streaming, function-calling).
- Manual verification against Redwood Dedicated staging (latency-sensitive routes) to validate retry behavior under load.

Notes and follow-ups:
- Follow-up: add telemetry span for retry decisions (ENG-4590).
- Follow-up: monitor streaming error rate for first-week post-release; toggle fallback policy if regressions observed.

Merge: Squash and merge to main.

This PR is part of the v1.154.1 SDK coordinated release which includes release artifacts for python/typescript/go and updated examples in redwood-examples repo. If any downstream packaging or marketplace steps are required, tag the release manager and create the release pipeline job.
